programme.desc: Les parcours de Florence Foresti, Omar Sy et Stromae, de leurs débuts au sommet de leur carrière.

programme.title: Very Good Girls
programme.desc: Lors de leur premier été après la fin du lycée, deux adolescentes new-yorkaises se promettent de perdre leur virginité. Lorsqu'elles tombent toutes les deux amoureuses du même artiste de street art, l'amitié des deux jeunes filles est mise à rude épreuve pour la première fois.

programme.title: Hold Up
programme.desc: Plusieurs braquages opérés par des gangs différents ont lieu simultanément dans la même banque. Un des otages tente de comprendre les raisons de cette troublante coïncidence. Mais en tombant sous le charme d'une guichetière aguicheuse, la tâche ne lui est pas facilitée...

programme.title: Docteur T et les femmes
programme.desc: Un gynécologue attractif (Richard Gere), pris dans les tourments d'une crise de la cinquantaine, a autant de difficultés avec sa famille qu'avec sa propre vie. Par chance, il rencontre une femme (Helen Hunt) qui pourrait bien être la solution à ses problèmes

programme.title: Mon chat, mon chien... et les autres ?
programme.desc: Lors d'un événement surnaturel, le chien et le chat d'Emma sont transformés en deux jeunes hommes parfaits. La jeune femme d'abord surprise, apprend à les connaître différement.

programme.title: Ville-Marie
programme.desc: A l'arrêt d'autobus, Thomas Bernard assiste, impuissant, au suicide d'une jeune mère. Ebranlé, l'étudiant en architecture oublie son projet de se rendre à l'aéroport pour accueillir sa mère Sophie Bernard, grande actrice française de passage à Montréal pour le tournage d'un film réalisé par un ancien amant. Tandis que Sophie tente d'entrer en contact avec son fils, qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis trois ans, à l'hôpital Ville-Marie, l'infirmière Marie Santerre réconforte les ambulanciers Pierre et Benoît, qui n'ont pas réussi à sauver la désespérée à l'arrêt d'autobus. Dans les heures qui suivent, Marie, femme blessée, poursuit sa fuite en avant en enchaînant les quarts de travail. Le lendemain, Sophie retrouve enfin Thomas, et l'invite à un dîner d'anniversaire en tête-à-tête. En guise de cadeau, celui-ci demande à sa mère de lui révéler l'identité de son père, qu'il n'a jamais connu. Or, la réponse se trouve dans le film qu'elle est en train de tourner.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker s'aiment depuis 20 ans. A bord de leur vieux camping-car, ils rendent visite à leurs amis et famille et retournent sur les lieux de leur jeunesse. Depuis que Tusker est atteint d'une grave maladie, tous leurs projets ont été suspendus. Le temps est compté et être ensemble est désormais la chose la plus précieuse. Cependant, ce dernier voyage va mettre leur amour à rude épreuve.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire doit protéger sa fille lors d'un braquage qui a mal tourné dans un entrepôt.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un tueur à gages célèbre de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Conseils d'amour
programme.desc: Une assistante discrète écrit anonymement les conseils amoureux du podcast de son patron. Quand son journaliste préféré révèle être fan de l'émission, elle doit choisir entre vérité, carrière et sentiments.

programme.title: Le vignoble de Noël
programme.desc: Heather Rivera est l'animatrice la plus dévouée de Tannin TV, le service de streaming en ligne entièrement dédié au vin. Bien qu'elle ait promis à ses parents de passer les fêtes avec eux, son patron lui demande de travailler pendant les fêtes de fin d'année pour réaliser le reportage parfait : une histoire alliant vin, Noël et valeurs familiales afin d'attirer de nouveaux téléspectateurs. Si elle réussit, Heather pourra devenir productrice et touchera une prime de Noël conséquente. Le seul obstacle entre elle et des fêtes de fin d'année familiales idéales et un reportage parfait ? Rudy, le propriétaire de Knobloch Family Wines, un homme terriblement séduisant mais timide devant la caméra.

programme.title: La destination de Noël
programme.desc: Emma, dirigeante épuisée d'une entreprise de jouets, rêve d'échapper à Noël. Mais une erreur d'avion l'emmène dans une ville d'Alaska entièrement dédiée aux fêtes, où Connor pourrait lui redonner goût à Noël.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sous les flocons
programme.desc: Une photographe en quête d'un rare flocon de neige à douze côtés embarque avec une amie d'enfance dans une aventure hivernale qui pourrait transformer leur vie.

programme.title: Monsieur Noël et moi
programme.desc: Zoé convainc Sam, libraire discret, de participer au concours « Monsieur Noël » afin de promouvoir son agence. Mais au fil des épreuves festives, leur relation devient bien plus personnelle.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Quand il apprend qu'une chauve-souris blanche et sacrée, Shikaka, a disparu au coeur de l'Afrique, Ace Ventura abandonne sa retraite himalayenne pour retrouver le petit animal. Deux tribus, les Wachati et les Wachootoo, vénérant l'animal, se rejettent la responsabilité de sa disparition.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Stripes (1981)
programme.desc: Lorsque John Winger (Bill Murray) perd son travail, sa voiture, son appartement et sa petite amie dans la même journée, il décide qu'il n'a qu'une solution : se porter volontaire pour l'armée. Et il persuade son ami Russell (Harold Ramis) à s'engager avec lui. Ils ont bien réfléchi et l'armée n'est-elle pas le lieu idéal pour défendre les valeurs du monde démocratique...

programme.title: Couple de Stars
programme.desc: Kiki est l'assistante dévouée de la belle et égocentrique star de cinéma Gwen Harrison, qui n'est autre que sa sœur. Ce qui est le plus dur, ce n'est pas de supporter les mille et un caprices de madame la grande actrice, c'est d'être secrètement amoureuse de son futur ex-mari, l'irrésistible Eddie, lui aussi acteur.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: Lanie est une journaliste télé ambitieuse, convaincue qu'avoir la plus parfaite des coiffures, le plus beau des amants et le plus luxueux des appartements est ce qui rend véritablement heureux...

programme.title: Braquage à New York
programme.desc: Henry, un percepteur de péage, est injustement emprisonné après avoir aidé sans le savoir des amis à commettre un vol de banque. En prison, il se lie d'amitié avec Max, un escroc charmant. Après avoir purgé sa peine, Henry découvre un vieux tunnel reliant la banque à un théâtre.

programme.title: Oncle Drew
programme.desc: Un jeune propriétaire d'équipe et l'Oncle Drew (la star de la NBA Kyrie Irving) rassemblent l'ancienne équipe de basket de Drew pour prouver qu'un groupe de septuagénaires peut encore gagner.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Jeunes diplômés tout juste sortis de l'université, Will (Teller) et Jillian (Kendrick) se voient rapidement confrontés aux obstacles auxquels les jeunes font face aujourd'hui sur un marché de l'emploi où la concurrence fait rage.

programme.title: Van Wilder: The Rise of Taj
programme.desc: Après avoir découvert, grâce à son légendaire mentor Van Wilder, les plaisirs les plus charnels, Taj Badalandabad (Kal Penn) part en Angleterre étudier à la prestigieuse Université de Camford.

programme.title: Jusqu'à la dernière goutte de sang
programme.desc: Un service de paie de l'armée est dévalisé par Billy Gun. L'armée engage Clive Norton pour récupérer l'argent. Pour l'aider, Norton sauve de la potence un homme qui méprise Gun.

programme.title: Demande pardon à Dieu, pas à moi...
programme.desc: Alors que Cjamango est absent de son ranch, six bandits attaquent et tuent tous les membres de sa famille. Bouleversé par cette tragédie, il entreprend de se venger.

programme.title: Une minute pour prier, une seconde pour mourir
programme.desc: L'apparition de Clay McCord déclenche une violente confrontation entre le marshal local, McCord et d'autres hors-la-loi.

programme.title: La mort tragique de Leland Drum
programme.desc: Une femme mystérieuse persuade deux cow-boys de l'aider dans un plan de vengeance.

programme.title: Ciakmull, le bâtard de Dodge City
programme.desc: Un jeune homme qui a perdu la mémoire s'échappe de prison avec trois autres détenus.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans un combat contre les forces envahissantes du tsar russe.

programme.title: L'esclave d'Orient
programme.desc: Antigonus, archonte de Corinthe, souhaite construire un magnifique temple dédié à la déesse Aphrodite, pour lequel le peuple est opprimé par de nouvelles taxes très élevées. Le sculpteur Démétrius, chargé de réaliser le visage de la déesse Diane, tombe amoureux d'une esclave, la chrétienne Lerna. Avec l'arrivée de la peste, le mécontentement du peuple grandit et Antigonus accuse facilement les chrétiens, qui sont immédiatement arrêtés et condamnés à mort. Les troupes romaines arrivent pour rétablir l'ordre, sauvant les deux amants Démétrius et Lerna.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Au-dela de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Arcadian
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, Paul et ses fils, Thomas et Joseph, luttent pour continuer à vivre dans un monde où, chaque nuit, des créatures rôdent et attaquent férocement. La famille vit dans une ferme isolée en pleine campagne et se soumet à des règles strictes de sécurité. Un soir, Thomas ne rentre pas.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Après qu'une pandémie virale a frappé le monde, John Wood a laissé derrière lui les vestiges d'une civilisation brisée pour retourner à ses racines dans les bois.

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Le dernier refuge: Au revoir monde
programme.desc: Alors qu'une attaque cyberterroriste plonge le monde dans le chaos, un groupe d'amis trouve refuge dans une maison de campagne. Confrontés à un avenir incertain, des tensions font surface.

programme.title: Sentinelle
programme.desc: Sur une base militaire isolée au bord d'un vaste océan, deux soldats attendent la fin de leur service de deux ans. Lorsqu'il y a un retard et que le navire tant attendu arrive vide, la tension entre eux commence à monter, et la situation devient incontrôlable.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: Mermaid le Lac des Âmes Perdues
programme.desc: Après une étrange rencontre nocturne, Roman est frappé par une malédiction liée à son passé. Sa fiancée Marina tente de le sauver, prête à tout pour briser l'emprise surnaturelle.

programme.title: Boston Streets
programme.desc: Deux amis d'enfance du sud de Boston se tournent vers le crime pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Jurassic Domination
programme.desc: Deux dinosaures conçus dans un laboratoire militaire attaquent une petite ville de montagne.

programme.title: The Rage
programme.desc: Une épidémie de rage se déclare dans la taïga russe.

programme.title: L'ENFER DES LOUPS
programme.desc: En 1850, des meurtres terrifient un village. Un marchand itinérant, Manuel Romasanta, cache un sombre secret lié à la légende du loup-garou.

programme.title: Le roi des Rats
programme.desc: Un groupe de rats mutants attaque des êtres humains.

programme.title: Ed Kemper, portrait d'un Serial Killer
programme.desc: Libéré après un premier meurtre, le tueur en série Edmund Kemper s'attaque à huit femmes en 1972.

programme.title: Monster Boy
programme.desc: Lié à la pègre, un garçon au passé sombre doit participer à des meurtres.

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: Un inspecteur corrompu et accro enquête sur un viol pour trouver la rédemption.

programme.title: L'attentat
programme.desc: À Tel Aviv, un chirurgien découvre un lourd secret sur sa femme après un attentat.

programme.title: Hungry Hearts
programme.desc: Jude est Américain, Mina Italienne. Ils se rencontrent à New York, tombent fous amoureux et se marient. Lorsque Mina tombe enceinte, une nouvelle vie s'offre à eux. Mais l'arrivée du bébé bouleverse leur relation.

programme.title: Déchaînés
programme.desc: Alors que les célèbres criminels Gary Tison et Randy Greenwalt s'évadent de prison, leur cavale se transforme rapidement en une sanglante chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: Route vers l'enfer
programme.desc: Mitchell et Carter, deux amis de longue date, se retrouvent en panne le long d'une route isolée en plein désert. Au fil des heures les tensions grandissent et finissent par exploser de manière assez brutale.

programme.title: Cortex
programme.desc: Voilà des mois que Hagen, un quadra mal dans sa peau, souffre de troubles du sommeil qui renforcent sa paranoïa. Il imagine que sa femme Karoline le trompe. Tout bascule le jour où son épouse a une aventure avec Niko, un jeune voyou.

programme.title: Slice
programme.desc: Un flic libère un tueur à gages pour traquer un serial killer qui vise l'élite thaïlandaise.

programme.title: Rebirth Island
programme.desc: À la chute de l'URSS, un colonel dirige un labo secret d'armes biologiques sur l'île de Rebirth.

programme.title: The Wretched
programme.desc: Un adolescent provocateur affronte une sorcière de mille ans.

programme.title: Au bout du tunnel
programme.desc: Un ingénieur paraplégique entend des bruits et les voix de braqueurs de banques dans son sous-sol.

programme.title: Stalingrad (2013)
programme.desc: Dans une ville dévastée par l'armée allemande, des soldats russes déterminés se battent pour maintenir leur position dans un immeuble stratégique et se lient d'amitié avec une compatriote.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: Kyle Snowden est un ancien marine qui travaille à présent dans la protection de l'enfance. A la suite d'une prise d'otages au sein d'un supermarché tenu par le beau-père de Kyle, il tente de mettre en sécurité les clients, notamment un enfant dont il s'occupe…

programme.title: Turbo Kid
programme.desc: La civilisation a été détruite et les rares survivants tentent de s'organiser. Le Kid erre, se construisant des armes avec ce qui lui tombe sous la main. Il finit par devenir ami avec Apple, une jeune femme dynamique et un peu envahissante.

programme.title: Every Last One of Them
programme.desc: Un homme est à la recherche de sa fille disparue, mais sa recherche révèle un complot plus vaste impliquant un gros accord capitaliste qui fait dérailler Chinatown sur les droits de l'eau.

programme.title: Les derniers citoyens
programme.desc: Dans un monde postapocalyptique gangréné par des gangs sanguinaires, Nina (Kate Bosworth) et Mark (Tyler Hoechlin) arpentent des contrées sans foi ni loi pour trouver un refuge et, à bout de souffle, doivent rester solidaires pour survivre.

programme.title: Dangerous Man
programme.desc: Libéré après des années de prison injuste, Shane Daniels se retrouve au cœur d'une guerre de rue entre flics corrompus, mafia russe et trafiquants chinois pour protéger une jeune femme.

programme.title: Run Hide Fight
programme.desc: Dans un lycée attaqué par des tireurs, Zoe, 17 ans, utilise son intelligence et son courage pour sauver ses camarades.

programme.title: Phoenix Forgotten
programme.desc: En 1997, trois adolescents disparaissent dans le désert après avoir filmé les lumières mystérieuses apparues au-dessus de Phoenix.

programme.title: Contre Enquête
programme.desc: Après le suicide suspect d'un soldat revenu d'Afghanistan, une journaliste refuse la version officielle et enquête sur une vérité plus sombre.

programme.title: Good Boy
programme.desc: Un chien fidèle accompagne son maître dans une maison de campagne isolée. Mais bientôt, il perçoit des forces surnaturelles tapies dans l'ombre. Alors que ces entités malveillantes menacent son compagnon humain, le courageux animal doit livrer un combat acharné pour protéger celui qu'il aime plus que tout.

programme.title: Your Monster
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Watch Out
programme.desc: Dans un quartier résidentiel calme, la jeune Ashley est loin de se douter de ce qui l'attend quand un cambriolage transforme sa nuit de baby-sitting en un véritable cauchemar de Noël.

programme.title: Vampires en Toute Intimité
programme.desc: En Nouvelle-Zélande, une équipe s'installe dans la demeure de vampires afin de tourner un documentaire sur leur mode de vie. Les créatures tentent de sortir dans les bars, pensent nettoyer le sang après leurs méfaits, cherchent un style vestimentaire et découvrent Google. Elles doivent également faire face à un nouveau venu de leur espèce, très peu discret.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale Fightent le Mal
programme.desc: Tucker et Dale sont deux bouseux au grand cœur partis se ressourcer en pleine forêt. Mais leur route croise celle de jeunes étudiants fêtards qui, à la suite d'un quiproquo entraînant la mort de l'un d'entre eux, prennent Tucker et Dale pour des tueurs psychopathes et décident de leur faire la peau...

programme.title: Dagon
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un voilier s'échoue sur la côte espagnole, deux naufragés cherchent refuge à Imboca, un village isolé. Mais derrière son apparente ruine, la ville cache une secte vouée à Dagon, une divinité marine avide de sacrifices.

programme.title: Intro
programme.desc: Quand un bateau est coulé par un requin à deux têtes, les survivants se réfugient sur un atoll désert. Mais lorsque celui-ci commence à être submergé par les eaux, plus personne n'y est en sécurité.

programme.title: Sharks Silencieux et Mortels
programme.desc: Quand un bateau est coulé par un requin à deux têtes, les survivants se réfugient sur un atoll désert. Mais lorsque celui-ci commence à être submergé par les eaux, plus personne n'y est en sécurité.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: The Box
programme.desc: Adam reçoit de la part d'un proche une mystérieuse boite contenant un terrible secret.

programme.title: The Communion Girl
programme.desc: En 1987, Sara et son amie trouvent une poupée de communiante qui déclenche une série d'horreurs.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: Ancien membre de la Delta Force, puis agent spécial au FBI, Frank Castle s'apprête à se retirer pour mener une existence paisible auprès de sa femme et de son jeune fils. Lors de son ultime mission, les choses tournent mal et le fils de Howard Saint, puissant businessman et magnat de la pègre, est tué. Ivre de vengeance, Saint organise le massacre de Frank et de toute sa famille.

programme.title: Tigre Et Dragon
programme.desc: Élu "Meilleur Film de l'année" par plus de 100 critiques américains ! Deux maîtres guerriers (Chow Yun Fat et Michelle Yeoh) affrontent leur plus grande épreuve suite au vol de l'épée de la Destinée. Une jeune aristocrate (Zhang Ziyi) se prépare à un mariage arrangé et révèle ses incroyables talents de combat et son passé romantique. Bien que tous les guerriers luttent pour la justice, ils affrontent leurs pires ennemis et le pouvoir inévitable et puissant de l'amour. Avec des paysages somptueux de la Chine du 19ème siècle, CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON est un blockbuster plein d'action du réalisateur acclamé Ang Lee (Sense and Sensibility, The Ice Storm) qui offre d'impressionnantes chorégraphies d'arts martiaux de Yuen Wo Ping (Matrix).

programme.title: Lake Placid : Héritage
programme.desc: De jeunes explorateurs s'aventurent sur un mystérieux lac retiré des cartes modernes, en quêtes de secrets à explorer. Ils y découvrent une île dans laquelle se trouve un laboratoire abandonné, mais s'aperçoivent qu'elle abrite quelque chose de terrifiant : un prédateur des plus mortel. Avant même qu'ils n'aient temps de faire demi-tour, nos aventuriers sont pris au piège. Ils vont rapidement devoir mettre leur rivalité de côté pour réagir ensemble, s'ils veulent avoir la moindre chance de rester en vie…

programme.title: Lake Placid: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: Les crocos sont de retour, plus gros, plus vicieux et plus voraces que jamais. Après leur dernière attaque mortelle, le gouvernement les a envoyé dans une réserve protégée … où ils ont atteint une taille record, attendant leur dernière chance de dévorer de la chair humaine. Et lorsque une équipe de natation se retrouve prise au piège sur leur territoire… le dîner est servi ! Retrouvez Yancy Butler (surivivante de Lake Placid 3) et Robert Englund (le mythique interprète de Freddy Krueger) dans le dernier chapitre de la saga la plus mordante du cinéma d'horreur !

programme.title: Searching
programme.desc: Alors que Margot, 16 ans, a disparu, l'enquête ouverte ne donne rien et malgré les heures décisives qui s'écoulent, l'inspectrice chargée de l'affaire n'a pas le moindre indice. Le père, David (John Cho), décide alors de mener ses propres recherches, en commençant par là où personne n'a encore regardé : l'ordinateur de sa fille. Dans un thriller hyper moderne tourné uniquement à travers des appareils technologiques que l'on utilise quotidiennement pour communiquer, David doit impérativement retrouver la trace de sa fille avant qu'elle ne disparaisse pour toujours.

programme.desc: Chargée de vendre une maison sombre, une agent affronte un passé et un ado troublés.

programme.title: Angle doré : Forces spéciales

programme.desc: Eight London drag queens tell their stories in this striking new documentary. Contrasting the glamour, fun and witty humour you'd expect from London drag with personal stories of growing up and the unrelenting resilience drag gives them to face life. For these beautiful humans and talented artists, drag is not a cheap thrill, it is a way of life. After an attack on a London bus posted online, a documentary team went to interview the queen and his mum, who had never seen him in drag before...

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Footballer Leah Williamson discusses how getting through a major injury has made her love the person she is now more than the one she was before because of the way she looks after herself. Leah talks about the importance of listening to your own body, and trusting what it's trying to tell you rather than ignoring or overriding it.

Timothy's parents abandon him as a child, leaving him living on the streets and battling starvation during the famine. Incredibly, he manages to escape but is captured by the Chinese Army and brutally tortured for his defection. His incredible journey to freedom ends with the actions of a 13-year-old student who saved his life and granted him the chance to live in democracy.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

Take a moment to look past their robber masks and you'll find a remarkable set of creatures with stories you'll find nowhere else in the animal kingdom. It's time to lift the veil on the masked bandits!

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: Tundra

programme.title: World's Rarest
programme.desc: The world is facing an urgent biodiversity crisis. Untold numbers of animals are at risk of being lost forever, with many species racing towards extinction. In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: For centuries, pilgrims have set off on the Via Francigena in the hopes of reaching the tombs of the apostles Peter and Paul in Rome. The ancient pilgrimage route leads through the imposing Alps to the Great St Bernard Pass and from there cross-country through Italy: along the Aosta Valley and the endless rice fields of the Po Valley, over the mountains of the Apennines, and the rolling hills of Tuscany to Lazio – en route, modern pilgrims discover Italy's majestic and diverse landscapes, as well as traces of bygone eras. Along the way, they meet people who share with them their enthusiasm for the country and the tradition of pilgrimage.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: A classic case of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, Genene Jones killed at least 47 patients with the muscle relaxant succinylcholine while working at Bexar Medical Center in Texas. She loved creating emergencies, the excitement of a 'code blue' and especially the reactions of family members when told of the death of a loved one. She wailed endlessly at the death of each patient and insisted on accompanying the body to the morgue. With no reliable testing available for the presence of succinylcholine, Jones continued her killing spree, even in the face of accusations by her co-workers who had estimated that even young children were 25 percent more likely to die of cardiac arrest while in Jones' care. Jones is finally stopped in her tracks when an expensive test is developed in Sweden that reliably detects succinylcholine in human tissue samples.

Jones is finally stopped in her tracks when an expensive test is developed in Sweden that reliably detects succinylcholine in human tissue samples.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

Convinta che creare una piccola celebrità natalizia sia facile grazie alla sua esperienza, Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: A Christmas Reunion

programme.title: Il pretore

Con un matrimonio ormai in crisi da tempo, Augusto, non particolarmente avvenente, sfrutta il potere e il prestigio della sua carica, per attrarre le donne. L'arrivo di Mario Landriani, assunto da Vanghetta come suo assistente, finirà per stravolgergli la vita.

programme.title: Una cavalla tutta nuda
programme.desc: Due abitanti di un povero villaggio devastato dalla siccità vengono inviati, ambasciatori improvvisati, presso il vescovo di Volterra per esporgli la drammatica situazione. Quando giungono a destinazione, avendo dimenticato il foglio delle richieste, si inventano tutto e finiscono nei guai. Si danno alla fuga e finiscono errabondi sulle colline intorno a Volterra.

programme.title: Decameron proibitissimo
programme.desc: Durante il primo Rinascimento italiano e l'epidemia di peste nera, un gruppo di giovani uomini e donne, in cerca di rifugio in una villa isolata appena fuori la città di Firenze, condivide diverse storie di adulterio e amore proibito.

programme.title: Nel giorno del signore
programme.desc: Margherita, soprannominata Fornarina, è l'amante di Raffaello. Beatrice, una nobildonna innamorata del famoso pittore, cerca di toglierla di mezzo, facendola accusare ingiustamente dell'omicidio di uno strozzino, che in realtà ha ucciso lei stessa. Fornarina viene condannato a morte. Riuscirà Raffaello a dimostrarla innocente?

programme.title: Il merlo maschio
programme.desc: Niccolò Vivaldi è un violoncellista che soffre di un forte complesso d'inferiorità, sia per la scarsa riuscita professionale, sia perché poco stimato e considerato dal prossimo. Quando scopre che sua moglie piace molto agli altri uomini, inizia a farla posare nuda.

programme.title: Gli Anni Ruggenti
programme.desc: Un modesto assicuratore arriva in una cittadina del Sud e viene scambiato per un gerarca fascista in incognito. Le autorità locali, prese dal panico, cercano di nascondere abusi e corruzione con risultati esilaranti.

programme.title: Cronache di poveri amanti
programme.desc: Grande classico di Carlo Lizzani con Marcello Mastroianni e Antonella Lualdi. Nel 1925, in pieno clima fascista, si intrecciano in un quartiere popolare di Firenze le vicende del tipografo Mario e della sua fidanzata, Bianca, con quelle degli altri abitanti. Nell'animato contesto, fra drammi personali, storie d'amore e piccole vicende quotidiane, la violenza politica nera scoppia brutalmente.

programme.title: La tratta delle bianche
programme.desc: A Genova, il criminale Machedi recluta giovani donne con false promesse per avviarle allo sfruttamento. Alda cerca di sottrarsi alla sua rete con l'aiuto di Carlo, ma l'uomo reagisce incastrando il giovane e attirando la ragazza in una crudele trappola.

programme.title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
programme.desc: La vita di Paolo (Marcello Mastroianni), un tranquillo e indolente autista di taxi, viene sconvolta dall'incontro con Lina (Sophia Loren), una bella ragazza, abile in borseggi e piccole truffe. Lina e la sua famiglia, sconclusionata come lei, affascinano Paolo che ce la mette tutta per redimere la ragazza. Con Vittorio De Sica nei panni del Prof. Stroppiani, padre di Lina.

programme.title: Il mio amico Jekyll
programme.desc: Grande commedia con Ugo Tognazzi e Raimondo Vianello. Il professor Giacinto, mite direttore di un istituto per ragazze malviventi, viene ogni notte rapito da un folle soprannominato "Dottor Jekyll," che gli inietta strani sieri. Giacinto si trasforma così nel sadico Professor Fabius, compiendo atti licenziosi e violenti sulle ragazze. Il suo segreto viene infine scoperto da un poliziotto.

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: Casanova 70
programme.desc: Andrea, ufficiale della Nato, è colpito da un`ossessione che lo spinge a compiere azioni rischiose per le sue conquiste galanti. Lo psicanalista, ascoltato il racconto delle sue avventure, gli rimprovera l`eccessiva frenesia amorosa e gli consiglia una vacanza di riposo in montagna. Ma anche in vacanza Andrea non perde il vizio di correre dietro alle donne...

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Furlough

programme.title: Luci d'inverno

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!

programme.title: Scambio di identità

programme.title: Il museo di Margaret
programme.desc: Margaret non avrebbe voluto sposare un minatore, unico lavoro per gli uomini del paese. Margaret sceglie la solitudine, ma un giorno conosce Neil, un artista che fa il lavapiatti. Quando perde il lavoro anche a lui non resta che scendere in miniera.

programme.desc: Accusata di aver ucciso il marito e di aver fatto sparire la sua amante, Jeri Gillen si rivolge al dottor Dewal, un ex poliziotto rimasto disabile, perché l'aiuti a provare la sua innocenza.
